title: Open 25.1
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Fifteen-minute AMRAP of lateral burpees over a dumbbell, dumbbell hang clean-to-overheads at 50/35 lb and a 30 ft walking lunge, with the burpees and clean-to-overheads climbing by 3 each round. Scaled used 35/20 lb; Foundations 20/10 lb and regular burpees.

items.name: Ladder 3-6-9-12… in 15 min
items.note: AMRAP 15: add 3 burpees and 3 clean-to-overheads each round; the lunge stays 30 ft. Listed to round 5. Score = total reps.
